description:
Architect-designed country home with equestrian facilities on about 3 acres.

Approached through an attractive entrance framed by mature planting, Riverside House is an impressive architect-designed contemporary residence set within approximately 3 acres of beautifully landscaped gardens and grounds. From the moment of arrival, the property conveys a wonderful sense of privacy and space, complemented by thoughtfully designed features and a picturesque countryside setting.

A practical covered portico shelters the main entrance, opening into a striking split-level living environment where vaulted ceilings and extensive floor-to-ceiling glazing maximise natural light and frame views of the surrounding gardens. The principal reception space is centred around a spacious west-facing lounge, finished with solid timber flooring and featuring a fireplace as its focal point. French doors open directly onto an expansive composite deck, providing a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor living and creating an ideal setting for entertaining or relaxation.

A series of sunken steps leads to the impressive double-height dining area, where porcelain tiled flooring, a solid-fuel stove and impressive dual-aspect floor-to-ceiling windows combine to create a wonderfully bright and atmospheric space. The open-plan kitchen is both stylish and functional, fitted with bespoke cabinetry, granite worktops and matching upstands, together with a central island incorporating a breakfast bar. Integrated appliances include an electric double oven and hob, dishwasher, wine fridge and American-style fridge freezer.

The ground floor accommodation is further enhanced by a spacious utility room, guest WC, built-in cloakroom and a well-appointed study with fitted storage, ideally suited to modern family life and home working.

At first-floor level, a generous light-filled landing overlooks the living spaces below and enjoys panoramic views across the gardens and woodland beyond, offering an ideal reading area or home office space. The bedroom accommodation comprises five generously proportioned double bedrooms. The principal suite benefits from an en suite bathroom and walk-in wardrobe, as well as two additional en suite bedrooms also with walk-in wardrobes. Two further double bedrooms provide excellent family accommodation, one of which includes additional dressing space. A spacious family bathroom with freestanding bath and separate shower completes the accommodation.

Gardens and Grounds

Riverside House stands within approximately 3 acres of mature and beautifully maintained gardens, woodland and grounds. To the rear, a feature pond fed by a gently flowing boundary stream provides a tranquil focal point, enhancing the sense of seclusion and connection with the surrounding landscape.

The property benefits from a substantial detached garage with roller door and a summer house. These versatile spaces offer considerable flexibility and may be suited to guest accommodation, home working or multi-generational living, subject to any necessary consents.

A particular highlight of the property is its excellent equestrian infrastructure including a stable block comprising two stables, turnout pen, tack room and feed store. With the renowned beaches of Curracloe 8km away, Riverside House offers a rare opportunity for equestrian enthusiasts to enjoy both quality on-site facilities and exceptional beach riding within easy reach.

Riverside House combines contemporary architectural design, extensive living accommodation and exceptional lifestyle amenities to create a superb country residence in one of County Wexford's most desirable locations.

Set amidst the picturesque countryside of County Wexford, Riverside House enjoys a peaceful and private setting in the townland of Kilcorral, approximately 8 km from Wexford Town. The thriving village of Castlebridge lies just 2.5 km away, while the renowned coastal destination of Curracloe, celebrated for its miles of unspoilt sandy beaches, is approximately 8 km from the property.

Occupying an enviable position in Ireland's sunny south-east, Riverside House offers the perfect balance between country living and convenience. Castlebridge provides a range of everyday amenities including schools, cafés and a pharmacy, while Wexford Town delivers an extensive selection of restaurants, boutiques, leisure facilities and cultural attractions. The town is perhaps best known for the internationally acclaimed Wexford Opera Festival, which attracts visitors from around the world each year.

Connectivity is excellent, with Dublin approximately 105 km away via the M11 motorway, while Dublin Airport is within easy reach at approximately 150 km. Waterford City is also readily accessible via the Ballyhack Ferry.

Educational facilities are particularly well catered for, with Castlebridge National School nearby and additional primary schools available in Screen and Curracloe. Secondary education options in Wexford Town include Loreto Secondary School, Presentation Secondary School, St Peter's College and Selskar College.

The surrounding area offers an exceptional range of recreational pursuits. Curracloe Beach and The Raven Nature Reserve are within easy reach, while nearby attractions include Johnstown Castle Estate, Wells House & Gardens and the charming village of Blackwater with its family-friendly amenities and open farm. Golf enthusiasts are spoiled for choice with courses at Wexford Golf Club, Blackwater Golf Course and the renowned Rosslare Golf Club. The coastline and waterways of the region also provide opportunities for sailing, fishing, kayaking and a variety of water sports.
